title: Going through the OS2 cooperative means one Magenta integration reaches many Danish municipalities
content:
Magenta's products, OS2mo and OS2borgerPC, serve Danish municipalities through the OS2 cooperative. The data involved is public-sector organisational data — which units exist, who belongs to them, with what role. The research notes that auditors must be able to reconstruct it, which is a claim about history rather than about present correctness.

The gap follows from that. Organisational structures change continuously, and a system holding the present structure cannot answer what the structure was on a given date or who changed it. That is precisely the question asked when a decision taken under an earlier arrangement is later challenged, and it cannot be answered by a more accurate snapshot.

The commercially decisive fact here is the channel rather than the gap. Because these products are distributed through the cooperative, one integration reaches many municipalities instead of one client. It is the same federated-buyer shape as the Dutch cooperatives elsewhere in the corpus, and it changes how much engineering effort a single integration can justify.
